summary: Data I/O Corp filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01 to disclose a private placement. The company entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with Lytton-Kambara Foundation and Alice W. Lytton Family LLC for $9 million aggregate consideration, comprising 869,840 common shares, a $6.825 million convertible five-year note bearing 4% interest (default 18%), and warrants for 1.08 million common shares. The note converts at $1,000 per share of non-voting Series B Convertible Preferred Stock, convertible into common at $2.50 per share, subject to shareholder approval. The placement is subject to customary closing conditions including regulatory approval. The filing is a capital-raising event, not a special situation like a tender offer or restructuring; watch for shareholder vote and conversion mechanics.
